Official customer prompts from Microsoft Industry GTM, “Post Ignite 2026 Customer Asset Prompts”

Ignite 2026 PPT deck

PowerPoint

A customer-specific deck with sourced priorities, relevant Ignite announcements, and a clear next step.

Role: You are a Microsoft account team preparing a short conversation-starter deck for [CUSTOMER].

Inputs:
Customer priorities:
- [Type customer priority 1]
- [Type customer priority 2]
- [Type customer priority 3]
- Microsoft Ignite 2026 Book of News: https://news.microsoft.com/events/ignite/2026/book-of-news/

Goal: Show the customer how 3–6 Ignite announcements connect to their priorities. The deck should open a business discussion and be anchored on customer outcomes, not pitch a product.

Build 7-10 slides:
- Title: "[Customer Name] + Microsoft: Ideas from Ignite 2026"
- What we heard from you: Summary of 3–6 of the customer's stated priorities, each tied to a public source (quote or headline with date).
- Then create one slide per priority (between 3 and 6 total): Your priority → What Microsoft announced → What it could mean for you (outcome in business terms)
- Questions to explore together: 4–5 open-ended questions for business leaders
- Suggested next step: a working session to pick 1–2 areas to go deeper on

Rules:
- Write in plain English. Use short sentences and no jargon or acronyms without explanation.
- Lead with the customer's words and outcomes. Microsoft comes second.
- Don't mention financials, pricing, revenue, stock, or deal size.
